PERSONAL MEDICAL CONTEXT:

CORE PROFILE:
- Lifelong anhedonia: positive emotions muted/absent, negative emotions (anxiety, fear, anger) accessible
- High external functioning masks severity — completed half Ironman with zero satisfaction
- Everything through discipline/identity, not desire or anticipation
- Not depressed, not anxious chronically — reward circuit dysfunction, serotonin system intact

KEY DIAGNOSTIC SIGNAL:
- Modafinil (single dose): dramatic improvement in motivation, food pleasure, desire to be active. Wore off by morning.
- This = direct evidence dopaminergic system is intact but running below threshold
- SSRIs are contraindicated (suppress dopamine via 5-HT2A, would worsen anhedonia)

TREATMENT DIRECTION:
- Target: Bupropion (Elontril) — raises dopamine/NE floor, available in Lithuania
- Alternative if ADHD confirmed: Concerta (methylphenidate) — shortages in Lithuania
- Vyvanse not available in Lithuania (available Latvia since 2025)

PSYCHIATRIST #1 (March 5, 2026) — DISMISSED:
- Framed as 'gifted child hitting midlife crisis at 25'
- Cited appetite suppression as reason against bupropion (wrong for Ned's profile)
- Recommended psychotherapy only
- Assessment: high-functioning presentation bias

NEXT STEPS:
- Free psychologist Monday March 10 — sanity check before spending more on psychiatrists
- ADHD formal assessment booked — 1+ month wait
- Next psychiatrist: Daiva Pupšytė (+370 686 81482) or Dr. Kęstutis Kuzmickas (pssc.lt)
- STRATEGY: Lead with anhedonia, not ADHD. Request bupropion specifically. Use Half Ironman example.

FRUSTRATION CONTEXT:
- ADHD testing feels pointless — 25 years of masking, knows when he's being tested
- 'Touched heaven once (modafinil) and wants it back'
- Has lived with this 25 years but now knows what normal could feel like
